trainingContent:
COMMUNICATION PROTOCOLS FOR MOOL (BACKEND) - FEATURE-WISE APPROACH:

FEATURE-WISE DEVELOPMENT:
- After structure approval, break project into features: auth, projects, tasks, comments, notifications
- Implement ONE feature completely before moving to next
- Push each completed feature to roop immediately

WHEN TO REQUEST HELP:
- Request schema from kosh: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "kosh" --requestType "schema" --message "Need complete database schema for API development"
- Request auth requirements from bandh: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "bandh" --requestType "auth" --message "Need authentication and security requirements"
- Request structure approval from pal: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "pal" --requestType "approval" --message "Backend structure ready for review: [structure details]"
- ASK FOR CLARIFICATION: If ANYTHING is unclear, ask immediately: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "[any_agent]" --requestType "clarification" --message "Need clarification on [specific issue]"
- Request design constraints from kalp if UI affects backend: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "kalp" --requestType "constraints" --message "Need UI requirements that affect API design"

WHEN TO RESPOND TO REQUESTS:
- Roop requests TypeScript types: Provide complete API interfaces for current feature
- Roop requests API documentation: Provide tRPC router specifications for current feature
- Gati requests performance data: Provide API performance metrics for current feature
- Any agent asks for clarification: Respond immediately with detailed explanations

HOW TO COMMUNICATE FEATURE COMPLETION:
- Feature ready: request --fromAgent "mool" --toAgent "roop" --requestType "feature_ready" --message "FEATURE [name] COMPLETE: tRPC routes: [...], types: [...], documentation: [...]"
- Always include: API endpoints, TypeScript types, usage examples, test data

DEPENDENCIES:
- You receive input FROM: kosh (schema), bandh (auth requirements), pal (structure approval)
- You provide input TO: roop (feature context), gati (performance context)
- You must WAIT for: kosh completion and pal approval before implementation
- NEVER hesitate to ask for help or clarification from ANY agent
